changeSet.author: archiv
changeSet.sql: create table export ( id uuid not null constraint export_pk primary key, geschaeftsjahr int not null constraint export_geschaeftsjahr_ck check (geschaeftsjahr between 1900 and 2999), status text not null constraint export_status_ck check (status in ('OFFEN', 'FERTIG', 'FEHLER')), s3_schluessel text, s3_version text, sha256 text constraint export_sha256_ck check (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), groesse bigint constraint export_groesse_ck check (groesse >= 0), anzahl int constraint export_anzahl_ck check (anzahl >= 0), benutzer text not null, rolle text not null, erstellt timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(), fertig timestamptz, fehler_id uuid, constraint export_fertig_ck check ((status = 'FERTIG') = (fertig is not null and sha256 is not null and s3_schluessel is not null and s3_version is not null and anzahl is not null)) ); create index export_erstellt_ix on export (erstellt desc); create unique index export_offen_uk on export ((true)) where status = 'OFFEN';
